title: Jingle Bells
credit: Words and music: James Lord Pierpont, published 1857 (Oliver Ditson & Co., Boston) as "The One Horse Open Sleigh"; the familiar refrain tune is on record by 1898.
how: note/length/syllable; lengths in beats (a beat is a quarter note); | is a bar line; r is a rest; a syllable ending in - continues the word; _ carries the syllable before it onto another note. Written in D (the first editions are in A flat and G); the arrangement and the key are ours.
